field_errors.evidence: solid electrolyte (Li2O-Al2O3SiO2-TiO2-GeO2-P2O5, LATP, 10-4 S cm-1, 25.4-mm square by 150-µm thick, Ohara Inc. Japan)

verdicts.explanation: The material (LATP) and the 10^-4 S cm-1 value match the paper's commercial-plate description, and the null temperature and secondary fields are correct. However, the value is an uncited vendor-style specification of the purchased Ohara plate, not a value from an earlier publication, so labelling it literature_cited misstates its provenance; under strict review the origin is not supported.
